name: Sangolli Rayanna
tagline: The fearless warrior who never surrendered
story: Sangolli Rayanna was a military chief of Kittur and a brave freedom fighter who fiercely resisted British rule. Born in Sangolli village of Dharwad, he was the commander of Kittur Chennamma's forces. After Chennamma's capture, he continued the revolt alone, destroying British camps and supply lines. He was eventually captured and hanged by the British in 1831. He remains one of Karnataka's greatest heroes of resistance.
storyKannada: ಸಂಗೊಳ್ಳಿ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ಸೇನಾಧಿಪತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ತೀವ್ರವಾಗಿ ವಿರೋಧಿಸಿದ ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರ.

name: Kittur Chennamma
tagline: The queen who fought the British before the 1857 revolt
story: Kittur Chennamma was the queen of Kittur who led an armed uprising against the British East India Company in 1824 — more than 30 years before the 1857 revolt. When the British tried to annex her kingdom, she took up arms and defeated them in the first battle. She was eventually captured and died in prison in 1829, but her courage inspired generations of freedom fighters across India.
storyKannada: ಕಿತ್ತೂರು ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ರಾಣಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, 1824 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಈಸ್ಟ್ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕಂಪನಿ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಸಶಸ್ತ್ರ ದಂಗೆಯನ್ನು ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಿದರು.

name: Akka Mahadevi
tagline: The mystic poet who chose God over a kingdom
story: Akka Mahadevi was a 12th century Kannada poet and Veerashaiva saint who became one of the earliest voices for spiritual equality. Born in Udutadi, Shivamogga, she rejected the marriage to King Kausika and devoted her life to Lord Shiva. Her Vachanas speak of love, freedom, and devotion in simple yet powerful words. She walked away from worldly life and became a symbol of spiritual courage.
storyKannada: ಅಕ್ಕ ಮಹಾದೇವಿ 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕವಿ ಮತ್ತು ವೀರಶೈವ ಸಂತರಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಸಮಾನತೆಗಾಗಿ ಮೊದಲ ಧ್ವನಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಾದರು.

name: Kuvempu
tagline: The poet who gave Karnataka its anthem
story: Kuppali Venkatappa Puttappa, known as Kuvempu, was one of Karnataka's greatest literary figures. Born in Kuppali, Chikkamagaluru, he wrote the beloved poem 'Jaya Bharata Jananiya Tanujate' which became the Karnataka state anthem. He was the first Kannada writer to receive the Jnanpith Award and was honoured with the title Rashtrakavi. His works celebrate nature, humanity, and the spirit of Karnataka's hills and forests.
storyKannada: ಕುಪ್ಪಳಿ ವೆಂಕಟಪ್ಪ ಪುಟ್ಟಪ್ಪ, ಕುವೆಂಪು ಎಂದು ಪರಿಚಿತರಾದ ಅವರು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು.

name: Basavanna
tagline: The saint who fought caste 900 years ago
taglineKannada: 900 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಜಾತಿ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ಸಂತ
story: Basavanna was a 12th century philosopher, social reformer, and statesman born in Bagewadi, Bagalkot. He founded the Lingayat movement and fought fiercely against the caste system, untouchability, and gender discrimination. He established the Anubhava Mantapa, one of the world's first democratic spiritual parliaments, where people of all castes and genders could speak freely.
storyKannada: ಬಸವಣ್ಣ 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಿ, ಸಮಾಜ ಸುಧಾರಕ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜಕಾರಣಿ, ಬಾಗಲಕೋಟೆಯ ಬಾಗೇವಾಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರು.

name: Nadaprabhu Kempegowda
tagline: The visionary who built the city of Bengaluru
story: Hiriya Kempegowda, also known as Nadaprabhu Kempegowda, was a chieftain under the Vijayanagara Empire who founded the city of Bengaluru in 1537. Born in Yelahanka, he planned the city with a vision for its future, building tanks, temples, and roads. He constructed four watchtowers at the city's boundaries to mark its planned expansion. Today, Bengaluru is one of the world's major technology hubs.
storyKannada: ಹಿರಿಯ ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ, ನಾಡಪ್ರಭು ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ ಎಂದೂ ಪರಿಚಿತರಾದ ಅವರು 1537 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ನಗರವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದರು.

name: Onake Obavva
tagline: The woman who held a fort with just a pestle
taglineKannada: ಒಂದೇ ಒನಕೆಯಿಂದ ಕೋಟೆ ಕಾದ ವೀರ ಮಹಿಳೆ
story: Onake Obavva was a brave woman from Chitradurga who single-handedly defended the Chitradurga fort against Hyder Ali's soldiers in the 18th century. While her husband was away, she discovered enemy soldiers sneaking in through a small hole in the fort wall. Using only her onake — a wooden pestle — she killed the soldiers one by one as they entered. She is celebrated as one of Karnataka's most iconic symbols of women's bravery.
storyKannada: ಒನಕೆ ಒಬವ್ವ ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗದ ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ಮಹಿಳೆ, 18ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೈದರ್ ಅಲಿಯ ಸೈನಿಕರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗ ಕೋಟೆಯನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿದರು.

name: Tippu Sultan
tagline: The Tiger of Mysore who died defending his kingdom
taglineKannada: ತನ್ನ ರಾಜ್ಯ ರಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಹೋರಾಡಿ ಮಡಿದ ಮೈಸೂರು ಹುಲಿ
story: Tippu Sultan, known as the Tiger of Mysore, was one of the most formidable opponents of British colonial rule in India. He ruled the Kingdom of Mysore and introduced many military innovations including rocket artillery. He fought four fierce Anglo-Mysore wars and died in battle in 1799 defending his capital Srirangapatna.
storyKannada: ಮೈಸೂರು ಹುಲಿ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಚಿತರಾದ ಟಿಪ್ಪು ಸುಲ್ತಾನ್ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ವಸಾಹತು ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಭಯಂಕರ ವಿರೋಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
tagline: The architect of the Indian Constitution
story: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar was the chief architect of the Indian Constitution and a fierce champion of rights for Dalits and marginalized communities. Despite facing extreme caste discrimination, he earned multiple doctorates from prestigious universities. He founded several organizations to fight for social justice and converted to Buddhism in 1956.
storyKannada: ಡಾ. ಬಿ. ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಭಾರತದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಮತ್ತು ದಲಿತರು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಚಿನ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ತೀವ್ರ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Allama Prabhu
tagline: The philosopher poet who questioned everything
story: Allama Prabhu was a 12th century mystic poet and Veerashaiva saint born in Balligave, Shivamogga. He was the president of the Anubhava Mantapa, the spiritual parliament founded by Basavanna. His Vachanas are celebrated for their deep philosophical questioning of ego, religion, and the nature of the divine.
storyKannada: ಅಲ್ಲಮ ಪ್ರಭು 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಅತೀಂದ್ರಿಯ ಕವಿ ಮತ್ತು ವೀರಶೈವ ಸಂತರಾಗಿದ್ದು ಶಿವಮೊಗ್ಗದ ಬಳ್ಳಿಗಾವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರು.

name: Rani Abbakka Chowta
tagline: The fearless queen who defeated the Portuguese
story: Rani Abbakka Chowta was the queen of Ullal near Mangaluru and one of India's first female freedom fighters. In the 16th century, she fiercely resisted Portuguese colonial attempts to capture her kingdom. She successfully repelled multiple Portuguese invasions. She is celebrated as Abhaya Rani — the fearless queen.
storyKannada: ರಾಣಿ ಅಬ್ಬಕ್ಕ ಚೌಟ ಮಂಗಳೂರು ಬಳಿಯ ಉಳ್ಳಾಲದ ರಾಣಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ಭಾರತದ ಮೊದಲ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Vishwamanava Kuvempu
tagline: The universal human who transcended religion
story: Kuvempu's concept of Vishwamanava — the Universal Human — remains one of Karnataka's most powerful philosophical contributions. He believed that humans must transcend the boundaries of caste, religion, language, and nation to become truly universal beings. His novels like Kanooru Heggadithi are masterpieces of Kannada literature.
storyKannada: ಕುವೆಂಪು ಅವರ ವಿಶ್ವಮಾನವ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ತಾತ್ವಿಕ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.

name: Narayana Guru
tagline: One caste, one religion, one God for humanity
taglineKannada: ಮಾನವ ಜಾತಿ ಒಂದೇ, ಧರ್ಮ ಒಂದೇ, ದೇವರು ಒಂದೇ
story: Narayana Guru was a saint and social reformer who had a profound influence on coastal Karnataka. His philosophy of one caste, one religion, one God for humanity challenged the rigid caste hierarchy of his time. He established temples that were open to all castes and fought against untouchability.
storyKannada: ನಾರಾಯಣ ಗುರು ಕರಾವಳಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರಿದ ಸಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜ ಸುಧಾರಕರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: King Vishnuvardhana
tagline: The warrior king who built the Belur temple
story: King Vishnuvardhana of the Hoysala dynasty commissioned the famous Chennakeshava temple at Belur in Hassan district in 1117 CE. The temple is a marvel of Hoysala architecture with intricate carvings that took over a century to complete. The Belur temple remains one of Karnataka's most treasured heritage sites.
storyKannada: ಹೊಯ್ಸಳ ರಾಜವಂಶದ ರಾಜ ವಿಷ್ಣುವರ್ಧನ 1117 ಸಿಇಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಸನ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಬೇಲೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಚೆನ್ನಕೇಶವ ದೇವಾಲಯವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದರು.

name: S. L. Bhyrappa
tagline: The greatest living Kannada novelist
story: S. L. Bhyrappa is one of the most celebrated Kannada novelists of the 20th and 21st centuries. Born in Solige, Hassan district, he has written over 24 novels exploring deep philosophical, historical, and social themes. His works like Vamshavriksha, Parva, and Aavarana have been translated into multiple Indian languages.
storyKannada: ಎಸ್. ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ 20 ಮತ್ತು 21ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಕಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು.

name: Hyder Ali
tagline: The iron-willed ruler who modernized Mysore
story: Hyder Ali was the Sultan of Mysore who rose from a soldier to become one of the most powerful rulers in South India. Born in Kolar, he modernized the Mysore army with French military techniques and was the first Indian ruler to use rocket artillery in warfare. He fought fiercely against the British and Marathas to protect his kingdom. His son Tippu Sultan continued his legacy of resistance against colonial rule.
storyKannada: ಹೈದರ್ ಅಲಿ ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಸುಲ್ತಾನರಾಗಿದ್ದು ಒಬ್ಬ ಸೈನಿಕನಿಂದ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ಆಡಳಿತಗಾರರಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದರು. ಕೋಲಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಅವರು ಫ್ರೆಂಚ್ ಮಿಲಿಟರಿ ತಂತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ಮೈಸೂರು ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಆಧುನೀಕರಿಸಿದರು.

name: Shishunala Sharifa
tagline: The saint poet who united Hindus and Muslims through song
taglineKannada: ಹಾಡಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಿಂದೂ-ಮುಸ್ಲಿಮರನ್ನು ಒಂದುಗೂಡಿಸಿದ ಸಂತ ಕವಿ
story: Shishunala Sharifa was a 19th century saint poet from Shishunala village in Haveri district. He wrote beautiful Kannada poems called Tathvapadas that celebrated the unity of all religions. His guru was a Hindu saint named Govinda Bhatta, and together they showed that love for God transcends all religious boundaries. His songs are still sung at festivals across Karnataka and promote communal harmony.
storyKannada: ಶಿಶುನಾಳ ಶರೀಫ 19ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಸಂತ ಕವಿ, ಹಾವೇರಿ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಶಿಶುನಾಳ ಗ್ರಾಮದಿಂದ ಬಂದವರು. ಅವರು ಎಲ್ಲ ಧರ್ಮಗಳ ಏಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಆಚರಿಸುವ ಸುಂದರ ಕನ್ನಡ ತತ್ವಪದಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದರು.

name: Keladi Chennamma
tagline: The queen who sheltered Rajaram against Aurangzeb
taglineKannada: ಔರಂಗಜೇಬ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಾಜಾರಾಮನಿಗೆ ಆಶ್ರಯ ನೀಡಿದ ರಾಣಿ
story: Keladi Chennamma was the queen of Keladi kingdom in Shivamogga who bravely sheltered Rajaram, son of Chhatrapati Shivaji, when he was fleeing from Aurangzeb's army. Despite pressure from the Mughal emperor, she refused to surrender him and stood firm in her decision. She was an able administrator and a courageous ruler who expanded the Keladi kingdom and maintained its independence.
storyKannada: ಕೆಳದಿ ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಶಿವಮೊಗ್ಗದ ಕೆಳದಿ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ರಾಣಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಔರಂಗಜೇಬನ ಸೈನ್ಯದಿಂದ ಪಲಾಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಛತ್ರಪತಿ ಶಿವಾಜಿಯ ಮಗ ರಾಜಾರಾಮನಿಗೆ ಧೈರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಆಶ್ರಯ ನೀಡಿದರು.

name: Gopal Krishna Gokhale
tagline: Gandhi's political guru and champion of education
taglineKannada: ಗಾಂಧಿಯ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಗುರು ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಕ
story: Gopal Krishna Gokhale had deep connections to Belagavi where the Indian National Congress held its famous 1924 session chaired by Mahatma Gandhi. He was one of the most respected leaders of the Indian independence movement and Mahatma Gandhi's political mentor. He founded the Servants of India Society to train people for public service and fought tirelessly for education, civil rights, and social reform through constitutional means.
storyKannada: ಗೋಪಾಲ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಗೋಖಲೆ ಬೆಳಗಾವಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದರು, ಅಲ್ಲಿ 1924ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಾತ್ಮಾ ಗಾಂಧಿ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಅಧಿವೇಶನ ನಡೆಯಿತು.

name: Purandaradasa
tagline: The father of Carnatic music who sang for the common people
taglineKannada: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಜನರಿಗಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸಂಗೀತದ ಪಿತಾಮಹ
story: Purandaradasa is celebrated as the father of Carnatic music. Born into a wealthy merchant family in Vijayanagara, he gave up all his wealth after a spiritual awakening and became a devoted saint-composer. He composed over 475,000 songs in Kannada and Sanskrit, of which about 1,000 survive today. He systematized the teaching of Carnatic music and his compositions are still used to teach music across South India.
storyKannada: ಪುರಂದರದಾಸ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸಂಗೀತದ ಪಿತಾಮಹ ಎಂದು ಆಚರಿಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವಿಜಯನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಅವರು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಜಾಗೃತಿಯ ನಂತರ ತಮ್ಮ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನು ತ್ಯಜಿಸಿ ಭಕ್ತ ಸಂತ-ಸಂಯೋಜಕರಾದರು.

name: Sir M. Visvesvaraya
tagline: The engineer who built modern Karnataka
story: Sir Mokshagundam Visvesvaraya was a world-renowned engineer and the Diwan of Mysore. He was the chief engineer of the Krishna Raja Sagara dam in Mandya. He was a visionary who focused on industrialization and education. His birthday is celebrated as Engineer's Day in India. He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1955.
storyKannada: ಸರ್ ಮೋಕ್ಷಗುಂಡಂ ವಿಶ್ವೇಶ್ವರಯ್ಯ ವಿಶ್ವಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ದಿವಾನರಾಗಿದ್ದರು. ಅವರು ಮಂಡ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷ್ಣರಾಜ ಸಾಗರ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟಿನ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Kengal Hanumanthaiah
tagline: The builder of the grand Vidhana Soudha
story: Kengal Hanumanthaiah was the second Chief Minister of Karnataka. He is most famous for the construction of the Vidhana Soudha, the state legislature building in Bengaluru, which is a marvel of Neo-Dravidian architecture. He was a visionary politician and a committed freedom fighter who worked for the unification of Karnataka.
storyKannada: ಕೆಂಗಲ್ ಹನುಮಂತಯ್ಯ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಎರಡನೇ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳಾಗಿದ್ದರು. ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಶಾಸಕಾಂಗ ಕಟ್ಟಡವಾದ ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧದ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅವರು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

name: Field Marshal K. M. Cariappa
tagline: The first Indian Commander-in-Chief of the Army
story: Field Marshal Kodandera Madappa Cariappa was the first Indian Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Army. Born in Kodagu, he was one of the two Indian Army officers to hold the five-star rank of field marshal. He led the Indian forces during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1947 and was known for his discipline and integrity.
storyKannada: ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ಮಾರ್ಷಲ್ ಕೊಡಂದೇರ ಮಡಪ್ಪ ಕಾರ್ಯಪ್ಪ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸೇನೆಯ ಮೊದಲ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಮಾಂಡರ್-ಇನ್-ಚೀಫ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದರು. ಕೊಡಗಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಇವರು ಶಿಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಗ್ರತೆಗೆ ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: General K. S. Thimayya
tagline: The legendary General of the Indian Army
story: General Kodendera Subayya Thimayya was a distinguished soldier of the Indian Army. He served as the Chief of Army Staff from 1957 to 1961. He is highly regarded for his leadership during various military operations and his work with the United Nations. He remains a hero and role model for people in his home district of Kodagu.
storyKannada: ಜನರಲ್ ಕೊಡಂದೇರ ಸುಬ್ಬಯ್ಯ ತಿಮ್ಮಯ್ಯ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸೇನೆಯ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಸೈನಿಕರಾಗಿದ್ದರು. ಅವರು 1957 ರಿಂದ 1961 ರವರೆಗೆ ಸೇನಾ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಮುಖ್ಯಸ್ಥರಾಗಿ ಸೇವೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು.

name: Da Ra Bendre
tagline: The poet of the soul and nature
story: Dattatreya Ramachandra Bendre was one of the most prominent Kannada poets of the Navodaya period. Known by his pen name Ambikatanayadatta, he was the second Kannada writer to win the Jnanpith Award. His poems like 'Hakki Harutide Nodidira' and 'Belagu' are celebrated for their lyrical beauty and deep philosophical meaning.
storyKannada: ದತ್ತಾತ್ರೇಯ ರಾಮಚಂದ್ರ ಬೇಂದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ನವೋದಯ ಕಾಲದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕವಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು. ಅಂಬಿಕಾತನಯದತ್ತ ಎಂಬ ಕಾವ್ಯನಾಮದಿಂದ ಇವರು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Shivaram Karanth
tagline: The giant of Kannada literature and culture
story: Kota Shivaram Karanth was a prolific novelist, playwright, and environmentalist. He was awarded the Jnanpith Award for his novel 'Mookajjiya Kanasugalu'. He worked tirelessly to revive the traditional dance form Yakshagana. He was also a strong advocate for children's education and wrote several science books for kids.
storyKannada: ಕೋಟ ಶಿವರಾಮ ಕಾರಂತರು ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಮೃದ್ಧ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಕಾರ, ನಾಟಕಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಸರವಾದಿ. ಅವರ 'ಮೂಕಜ್ಜಿಯ ಕನಸುಗಳು' ಕಾದಂಬರಿಗೆ ಜ್ಞಾನಪೀಠ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಲಭಿಸಿದೆ.

name: Kanakadasa
tagline: The warrior who became a saint-composer
story: Kanakadasa was a saint, philosopher, and musician born in Bada, Haveri district. He was a great devotee of Lord Krishna and belonged to the Haridasa movement. His compositions called Keerthanas are known for their simplicity and social messages against caste discrimination. The 'Kanakana Kindi' in Udupi Krishna temple is named after him.
storyKannada: ಕನಕದಾಸರು ಹಾವೇರಿ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಬಾಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಸಂತ, ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಗೀತಗಾರ. ಅವರು ಭಗವಾನ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಪರಮ ಭಕ್ತರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Sri Krishnadevaraya
tagline: The greatest emperor of the Vijayanagara Empire
story: Krishnadevaraya was the most famous ruler of the Vijayanagara Empire. Under his rule, the empire reached its peak of power and prosperity. He was a great patron of arts and literature, and his court was graced by the 'Ashtadiggajas' or eight legendary poets. He built many magnificent temples in Hampi, which are now UNESCO World Heritage sites.
storyKannada: ಕೃಷ್ಣದೇವರಾಯ ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಆಡಳಿತಗಾರ. ಇವರ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯವು ತನ್ನ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿಯ ಉತ್ತುಂಗವನ್ನು ತಲುಪಿತು.

name: Madhvacharya
tagline: The philosopher who founded the Dvaita school
story: Madhvacharya was a philosopher and the chief proponent of the Dvaita (dualism) school of Vedanta. Born in Pajaka near Udupi, he founded the famous Krishna Mutt in Udupi. He taught that the soul and God are distinct and that devotion to God is the path to liberation. He was a prolific writer and composed many works in Sanskrit.
storyKannada: ಮಧ್ವಾಚಾರ್ಯರು ವೇದಾಂತದ ದ್ವೈತ ಪಂಥದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಕರು ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಿ. ಉಡುಪಿ ಬಳಿಯ ಪಾಜಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಇವರು ಉಡುಪಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕೃಷ್ಣಮಠವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದರು.

name: Belawadi Mallamma
tagline: The warrior queen who fought Shivaji's army
taglineKannada: ಶಿವಾಜಿಯ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ವೀರ ರಾಣಿ
story: Belawadi Mallamma was the queen of Belawadi who fought bravely against the forces of Chhatrapati Shivaji in the 17th century. She was a skilled warrior and led her women's army in battle. Shivaji was so impressed by her courage and dignity that he eventually honored her and stopped the war, treating her with great respect.
storyKannada: ಬೆಳವಡಿ ಮಲ್ಲಮ್ಮ 17ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಛತ್ರಪತಿ ಶಿವಾಜಿಯ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಧೈರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ಬೆಳವಡಿಯ ರಾಣಿ.

name: Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay
tagline: The champion of Indian handicrafts and freedom
story: Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay was a social reformer and freedom fighter from Mangaluru. She played a key role in the salt satyagraha and was the first woman to run for a legislative seat in India. After independence, she worked tirelessly to revive Indian handicrafts, handlooms, and theater, helping millions of artisans across the country.
storyKannada: ಕಮಲಾದೇವಿ ಚಟ್ಟೋಪಾಧ್ಯಾಯ ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಸಮಾಜ ಸುಧಾರಕಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರ್ತಿ. ಇವರು ಭಾರತದ ಕರಕುಶಲ ಕಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನರುಜ್ಜೀವನಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಶ್ರಮಿಸಿದರು.

name: Umabai Kundapur
tagline: The silent leader of the freedom struggle
story: Umabai Kundapur was a prominent freedom fighter and social worker based in Hubballi. She founded the 'Bhagini Mandal' and served as the leader of the women's wing of the Seva Dal. She provided shelter and support to many freedom fighters who were underground. She was a simple and selfless leader who dedicated her life to the country.
storyKannada: ಉಮಾಬಾಯಿ ಕುಂದಾಪುರ ಹುಬ್ಬಳ್ಳಿಯ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜ ಸೇವಕಿ. ಇವರು ಸೇವಾದಳದ ಮಹಿಳಾ ವಿಭಾಗದ ನಾಯಕಿಯಾಗಿ ಸೇವೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು.

name: Hardekar Manjappa
tagline: The Gandhi of Karnataka
story: Hardekar Manjappa was a dedicated follower of Mahatma Gandhi and was known for spreading Gandhian ideals in Karnataka. Born in Banavasi, he worked as a journalist and social reformer. He promoted khadi, cleanliness, and simple living. He wrote several books and organized many events to educate people about social issues.
storyKannada: ಹರ್ಡೇಕರ್ ಮಂಜಪ್ಪ ಮಹಾತ್ಮಾ ಗಾಂಧಿಯವರ ಪರಮ ಅನುಯಾಯಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದರು ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಂಧಿವಾದದ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಚಾರ ಮಾಡಿದರು.

name: Gudleppa Hallikeri
tagline: The iron man of the Hosaritti struggle
story: Gudleppa Hallikeri was a leading freedom fighter from Haveri district. He was a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi and played a major role in the Quit India movement. He founded several educational institutions to provide quality education to rural students. He was known for his simplicity, discipline, and commitment to social service.
storyKannada: ಗುಡ್ಲೆಪ್ಪ ಹಳ್ಳಿಕೇರಿ ಹಾವೇರಿ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರು. ಇವರು ಕ್ವಿಟ್ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಚಳುವಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸಿದ್ದರು.

name: Karnad Sadashiva Rao
tagline: The selfless patriot of Mangaluru
story: Karnad Sadashiva Rao was a prominent freedom fighter and social reformer from Mangaluru. He dedicated his entire wealth and life to the upliftment of the poor and the cause of Indian independence. He founded the 'Mahila Sabha' to support women's education and worked closely with Mahatma Gandhi during the freedom struggle.
storyKannada: ಕರ್ನಾಡ್ ಸದಾಶಿವ ರಾವ್ ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜ ಸುಧಾರಕರು. ಇವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಆಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಬಡವರ ಏಳಿಗೆಗಾಗಿ ನೀಡಿದರು.

name: D. V. Gundappa
tagline: The philosopher poet of Mankuthimmana Kagga
story: Devanahalli Venkataramanayya Gundappa, popularly known as DVG, was a great scholar, poet, and philosopher. Born in Mulbagal, Kolar district, he is best known for his work 'Mankuthimmana Kagga', which is often referred to as the 'Bhagavad Gita of Kannada'. He also founded the Gokhale Institute of Public Affairs in Bengaluru.
storyKannada: ದೇವನಹಳ್ಳಿ ವೆಂಕಟರಮಣಯ್ಯ ಗುಂಡಪ್ಪ (ಡಿವಿಜಿ) ಒಬ್ಬ ಮಹಾನ್ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸ, ಕವಿ ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಿ. ಇವರು 'ಮಂಕುತಿಮ್ಮನ ಕಗ್ಗ' ಕೃತಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

name: Dr. Shivakumara Swamiji
tagline: The Walking God of modern Karnataka
story: Dr. Shivakumara Swamiji was the head of the Siddaganga Mutt in Tumakuru. He lived for 111 years and was widely revered as the 'Walking God'. He provided free food, shelter, and education to thousands of children from all backgrounds through his 'Trividha Dasoha' philosophy. He was a symbol of selfless service and spiritual wisdom.
storyKannada: ಡಾ. ಶಿವಕುಮಾರ ಸ್ವಾಮೀಜಿಯವರು ತುಮಕೂರಿನ ಸಿದ್ಧಗಂಗಾ ಮಠದ ಮುಖ್ಯಸ್ಥರಾಗಿದ್ದರು. ಇವರು ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಆಹಾರ, ವಸತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ನೀಡಿದರು.

name: S. Nijalingappa
tagline: The key architect of united Karnataka
story: Siddavanahalli Nijalingappa was a prominent politician and freedom fighter who served as the Chief Minister of Karnataka. He played a crucial role in the unification of all Kannada-speaking regions into a single state. He also served as the President of the Indian National Congress and was known for his simplicity and statesman-like qualities.
storyKannada: ಸಿದ್ದವನಹಳ್ಳಿ ನಿಜಲಿಂಗಪ್ಪನವರು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿಯಾಗಿ ಸೇವೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ರಾಜಕಾರಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರು.

name: Mailara Mahadevappa
tagline: The revolutionary hero who died for independence
story: Mailara Mahadevappa was a revolutionary freedom fighter from Motebennur in Haveri district. He was deeply inspired by Mahatma Gandhi and participated in the Dandi March. He later led a series of revolutionary activities against British rule. He was martyred in 1943 while attempting to capture a government building, becoming a symbol of supreme sacrifice.
storyKannada: ಮೈಲಾರ ಮಹಾದೇವಪ್ಪ ಹಾವೇರಿ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಮೊಟೆಬೆನ್ನೂರಿನ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಕಾರಿ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರು. ಇವರು ದಂಡಿ ಯಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಿದ್ದರು.

name: N. S. Hardikar
tagline: The founder of the Congress Seva Dal
story: Dr. Narayan Subbarao Hardikar was a freedom fighter and the founder of the Hindustani Seva Dal, which later became the Congress Seva Dal. Born in Dharwad, he worked to train and organize volunteers for the national movement. He was a strict disciplinarian and believed in the power of youth to bring social and political change in the country.
storyKannada: ಡಾ. ನಾರಾಯಣ ಸುಬ್ಬರಾವ್ ಹರ್ಡಿಕರ್ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಂದುಸ್ತಾನಿ ಸೇವಾದಳದ ಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು. ಇವರು ಧಾರವಾಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರು.

name: H. Narasimhaiah
tagline: The legendary educator and rationalist
story: Dr. Hosur Narasimhaiah was a freedom fighter, educator, and physicist. Born in Hosur, Kolar district, he served as the Vice-Chancellor of Bangalore University and the President of the National College, Basavanagudi. He was a prominent rationalist who fought against superstitions and worked to promote scientific temper among students and the general public.
storyKannada: ಡಾ. ಹೊಸೂರು ನರಸಿಂಹಯ್ಯ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರು, ಶಿಕ್ಷಣತಜ್ಞರು ಮತ್ತು ಭೌತವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದರು. ಇವರು ಮೂಢನಂಬಿಕೆಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಿದರು.

name: Madakari Nayaka
tagline: The last great ruler of the Chitradurga Fort
story: Madakari Nayaka was the bravest and last ruler of the Nayaka dynasty of Chitradurga. He successfully defended the fort against many invasions. He was known for his administrative skills and military tactics. He died fighting the forces of Hyder Ali. He remains an icon of valor and loyalty in the history of Chitradurga and Karnataka.
storyKannada: ಮದಕರಿ ನಾಯಕ ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗದ ನಾಯಕ ವಂಶದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊನೆಯ ಆಡಳಿತಗಾರ. ಇವರು ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗದ ವೀರತನದ ಸಂಕೇತವಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

name: Pampa
tagline: The Adikavi of Kannada literature
story: Pampa is regarded as the first great poet of Kannada literature, earned the title 'Adikavi'. He was the court poet of King Arikesari II. His masterpiece 'Vikramarjuna Vijaya' and 'Adipurana' are foundational works of Kannada literature. He famously said that he wished to be born as a little bee in the beautiful land of Banavasi in his next life.
storyKannada: ಪಂಪನನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಮೊದಲ ಮಹಾನ್ ಕವಿ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಲಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಇವರಿಗೆ 'ಆದಿಕವಿ' ಎಂಬ ಬಿರುದು ಇದೆ.

name: Ranna
tagline: The master poet of valor and Gada-yuddha
story: Ranna was one of the three gems of ancient Kannada literature. Born in Mudhol, Bagalkot district, he was the court poet of the Western Chalukya kings. His most famous work is 'Saahasabheema Vijaya' (also known as Gadayuddha), which describes the final duel between Bhima and Duryodhana. His works are known for their powerful imagery and dramatic intensity.
storyKannada: ರನ್ನ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ರತ್ನತ್ರಯರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು. ಇವರು ಬಾಗಲಕೋಟೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಮುಧೋಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರು.

name: Janna
tagline: The poet of love and sacrifice
story: Janna was a celebrated poet in the Hoysala court. Born in Halebidu, he wrote many important works including 'Yashodhara Charite' and 'Ananthanatha Purana'. He was given the title 'Kavichakravarthi' for his literary genius. His works explore complex human emotions and are considered masterpieces of medieval Kannada literature.
storyKannada: ಜನ್ನ ಹೊಯ್ಸಳ ಆಸ್ಥಾನದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕವಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದರು. ಹಳೇಬೀಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಇವರು 'ಯಶೋಧರ ಚರಿತೆ' ಮುಂತಾದ ಕೃತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

name: Harihara
tagline: The pioneer of the Ragale poetic form
story: Harihara, also known as Hampeya Harihara, was a revolutionary poet of the 12th century. He was a great devotee of Lord Virupaksha of Hampi. He introduced the 'Ragale' style of poetry to Kannada and wrote many works celebrating the lives of Shiva Saranas. His 'Basavarajadevara Ragale' is a significant work on the life of Basavanna.
storyKannada: ಹರಿಹರ ಅಥವಾ ಹಂಪೆಯ ಹರಿಹರ 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಕಾರಿ ಕವಿ. ಇವರು ಕನ್ನಡಕ್ಕೆ 'ರಗಳೆ' ಶೈಲಿಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿದರು.

name: Raghavanka
tagline: The master of the Shatpadi poetic form
story: Raghavanka was a nephew and disciple of the poet Harihara. He is famous for introducing the 'Shatpadi' (six-line verse) form to Kannada literature. His most celebrated work is 'Harishchandra Kavya', which tells the poignant story of King Harishchandra's truthfulness. He was a brilliant storyteller whose works have stood the test of time.
storyKannada: ರಾಘವಾಂಕ ಹರಿಹರ ಕವಿಯ ಸೋದರಳಿಯ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಷ್ಯ. ಇವರು ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ 'ಷಟ್ಪದಿ' ಶೈಲಿಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿದರು.

name: Shadakshari
tagline: The great poet of the Yelandur dynasty
story: Shadaksharadeva was a prominent Kannada poet of the 17th century. Born in the Yelandur region, he was a prolific writer in both Kannada and Sanskrit. His works like 'Rajshekhara Vilasa' and 'Vrishabhendra Vijaya' are known for their scholarship and poetic beauty. He was a key figure in the later phase of the classical Kannada literary tradition.
storyKannada: ಷಡಕ್ಷರದೇವ 17ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕವಿ. ಇವರು ಕನ್ನಡ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಎರಡರಲ್ಲೂ ಸಮೃದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

name: Sarvajna
tagline: The people's poet of the Tripadi
story: Sarvajna was a wandering poet and philosopher famous for his three-line poems called 'Tripadis'. Born in Haveri district, he shared deep wisdom on life, society, and ethics in simple language that common people could understand. His poems usually end with the word 'Sarvajna', and they are still widely quoted across Karnataka today.
storyKannada: ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಂಚಾರಿ ಕವಿ ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಿ. ಇವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಮೂರು ಸಾಲಿನ ಪದ್ಯಗಳಾದ 'ತ್ರಿಪದಿ'ಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

name: Krishnarao Panje
tagline: The pioneer of children's literature in Kannada
story: Panje Mangesh Rao, popularly known as Kavi Shishya, was a pioneer of children's literature in Kannada. Born in Bantwal, Dakshina Kannada, he wrote many delightful poems and stories for kids. He was a dedicated teacher and worked to improve the quality of education in the coastal region. His work laid the foundation for modern Kannada children's writing.
storyKannada: ಪಂಜೆ ಮಂಗೇಶರಾವ್ (ಕವಿ ಶಿಷ್ಯ) ಕನ್ನಡ ಶಿಶು ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಪ್ರವರ್ತಕರು. ಬಂಟ್ವಾಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಇವರು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಅನೇಕ ಸುಂದರ ಕವನಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
